scope: independent static holdout screen with the original fixed-grid recovery controller and nominal domain
case_scope: same first admitted static holdout per seven families, four leg combinations and two headings; missing admissions remain failures
physical_hook: after native simulate/fetch completion and original robot data update, before original contact reductions
clock: actual submitted dt committed by native fetch_results; no independent engine-time getter claim

contact.quantity: ground contact resultant for each named rigid body
contact.independent_integration: positive world-Z, per body over sliding 0.020 s with fractional oldest interval before part-group maximum
contact.enabled_mask: original not-passive and not-finished at the completed physical interval
contact.scored_mask: case remains active in the original external scorer; duplicate padding lanes excluded
contact.scope_limit: not self collision, individual contact patches, internal loads or structural stress

states: full native joint position, velocity and applied physical effort; root pose, COM velocity, body gravity and gyro
effort_channels: actual motor output after fixed-grid wheel response
native applied physical effort including passive contributions
history_channels: complete wheel command delay buffer and head
complete feedback position and velocity buffers, cursor and tick
domain torque and sensor buffers and cursors
history_cadence: each completed physical step; initial state separately without fabricated measured contacts
policy_channels: 35D input and 6D raw output from each existing actor call, prior control action, original tensor diagnostics including all named task failure flags and timeout flags
fault_attribution: simultaneous original flags at termination; no assertion of a unique causal fault
storage: bounded float32 memory-mapped lane arrays, float64 clocks and committed valid prefix in manifests; unused allocation is not observed data
source_binding: all recorded training source hashes must match; evaluation script, observer and contract hashes recorded separately
controller_mutations: none; wrappers return original results, capture copies and preserve the same response objects
limitations: observation archive is not a complete simulator checkpoint
native observer admission must be tested separately from CPU tests
no WheelBipe16001 handoff performed by this screen
same-case retest is not a new independent population
independent force re-integration is not a learned recovery or long-term capability qualification
